_comment: Step 9: every string a user reads, in English (the fallback for every other language). Keys must exist in en; other languages may only use keys that exist here (worker/test/i18n.test.mjs lists missing and extra keys). {name} style placeholders are filled by code. Plural forms: en/fr/hy one+other, ru one+few+many. Never an em or en dash.

digest.quiet: {hello}. Quiet period: nothing important on your topics {since}.
digest.quiet_line: Quiet period: nothing important on your topics {since}.

bot.welcome_times: I send you a short digest of the most important news at {times} ({zone}).
bot.welcome_next: Your next digest comes {when}. Tap {button} to change topics, times, language and more.
bot.help_new: Hi! Send /start and I will send you short news digests three times a day.
bot.help_paused: Your digests are paused. Send /start to turn them back on.
bot.help: I send news digests at {times} ({zone}). Your next one comes {when}. Send /settings to change them. I can't answer questions; the digest is all I do.
bot.settings: Choose your topics, language and when your digests arrive. Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
bot.support: Axiom News is free, and it stays free. If you like it, you can leave a voluntary tip in Telegram Stars: it helps keep Axiom running. Nothing is locked, and nothing changes for you whether you tip or not. By tipping you agree to the terms: /terms
bot.tip_description: A voluntary tip that helps keep Axiom News running. Nothing is unlocked: Axiom stays free for everyone.
bot.tip_thanks: Thank you for your tip of {amount} ⭐! It helps keep Axiom running. Your digests stay exactly the same.
bot.tip_bad: This tip amount is not available. Please use the buttons under /support.
bot.paysupport: A problem with a tip? Send /paysupport followed by a short note, for example: /paysupport 500 Stars by mistake. The owner of Axiom reads it and can refund a tip made by mistake. Telegram support cannot help with payments to bots.
bot.paysupport_sent: Thank you, your note was sent to the owner of Axiom. A tip made by mistake is refunded to your Stars balance.
bot.terms: Terms for tips. Axiom News is free. A tip in Telegram Stars is voluntary and unlocks nothing; it does not change your digests or settings. As a rule tips are not refunded, but a tip made by mistake is refunded on request through /paysupport. Telegram support cannot help with payments to bots. We keep only who tipped, the amount, Telegram's payment id and the time.

commands.support: Support Axiom with a voluntary tip
